_comment_1: HAND-AUTHORED — MCP server reference for the GitHub Copilot cloud agent.
_comment_2: The GitHub Copilot cloud agent does NOT auto-load this file from the repo. It reads MCP config from repository Settings → Copilot → Cloud agent → MCP configuration. Paste the contents of this file (excluding the leading `_comment_*` keys) into that settings panel to apply.
_comment_3: Tracking the config in the repo means changes go through PR review and are version-controlled. Mirrors the three servers wired in `.vscode/mcp.json` so VS Code and the cloud agent see the same tools.
_comment_5: Differences from `.vscode/mcp.json`: (1) top-level key is `mcpServers` (camelCase) not `servers`. (2) every server requires a `tools` allow-list — `*` enables all but is not recommended for the cloud agent. (3) secrets must be referenced as `$COPILOT_MCP_<NAME>` and configured in Settings → Copilot → Cloud agent → Environment.
